summary: Configured /srv/releases as a persistent release-team workspace with setgid group inheritance and verified it across a node restart.
actions_performed: Created /srv/releases with root:release-team ownership and mode 2775.
Verified a release-team process can create group-inherited files.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified workspace permissions, group, inherited files, and persisted test data after restart; removed test probes.

evidence.requirement: New files inherit release-team and team members can write
evidence.summary: Files created by root and by an unprivileged process using release-team both inherited the release-team group.
Captured the original boot identity and healthy workspace/data state, then received acknowledgement for the native systemd-scheduled reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity and recovered state
evidence.summary: Observed a new boot identity, running system state, persistent group and permissions, matching persisted-data hash, and successful post-restart group-write/inheritance behavior.
